name: poki2-portal
description: poki2.online — Free Browser Games Aggregation Portal

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-lastmod.js && node scripts/gen-favicons.js && node scripts/gen-og-image.js && node scripts/gen-game-og-images.js && node scripts/build.js
scripts.deploy: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name poki2-portal --commit-dirty=true && node scripts/purge-cache.js
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run deploy
